title: Design: Trie (Prefix Tree)
hints: Each node stores its children in a `[Character: Node]` dictionary.
`insert` walks and creates nodes; a shared `find(prefix)` powers both `search` (check `isEnd`) and `startsWith`.
`func search(_ w: String) -> Bool { find(w)?.isEnd ?? false }`.
jsBridge: A trie with `final class Node { var children: [Character: Node] }`. Classes are needed because nodes are shared and mutated through references. `Character` keys handle emoji and accents correctly.

compass.q: A JS trie with `{}` children vs Swift's `[Character: Node]`: what does grapheme-aware keying fix?
